_readme: Config for tools/lint/lint-run.ps1 (MediumRed-Studio/BGONE). Severity 'error' fails the run (exit 1); 'warn' prints without failing.

scan._comment: Globs are relative to the worktree root. tools/lint/selftest holds deliberate bad/good fixtures and is excluded from normal passes.

DIAG001_ShippedCodeReferencesDiag._why: scripts/Game/Diag/ holds dev-only QA bots and diagnostics that .github/workflows/main.yml strips on release. Any shipped file referencing a Diag symbol would fail to compile on main.

MP001_IdentityDerivedNotWire._why: A client controls its own RPC arguments. Any [RplRpc(..., RplRcver.Server)] handler accepting an acting-player identity parameter (playerId, senderPlayerId, pid, etc.) must derive identity from PlayerController.GetPlayerId() instead of trusting the wire value.

BOUNDARY003_ModdedClassStripsVanillaAttr._why: Enforce `modded class X` silently drops X's vanilla class attribute list (such as [BaseContainerProps()]), making the class invisible to configs. Add [InheritedAttribute()] directly above the modded class declaration.

GUID001_LocalRefMustResolve._why: Flags duplicate .meta GUIDs, dangling local/BGONE {GUID}path references, and references whose path disagrees (case-sensitively) with the owning .meta Name.
GUID001_LocalRefMustResolve._baselineNote: Pre-existing upstream SpaceStrider/BGONE findings on Dev @ 1a8751e (6 broken .meta Name paths causing 8 mismatches + 6 dangling GUIDs in upstream LauncherTest layers). Reported as info so PR 1 CI stays green while parallel PR 3 repairs the upstream metas/layers; stale entries warn once fixed so this debt ledger shrinks to empty.

UI001_WidgetNameContract._why: Verifies menu root FindAnyWidget literal names against bound .layout files and catches fatal Reforger layout keywords (OverlaySlot, SizeX/SizeY inside LayoutSlot, Visible, Text Horizontal/Vertical Align).

DOCS001_MojibakeSequence._why: Detects UTF-8 text accidentally decoded as cp1252 and re-encoded.

DOCS002_TransliterationDamage._why: Detects doubled question marks left by lossy legacy-codepage transliteration.

DOCS003_Utf8Bom._why: Markdown files must be UTF-8 without BOM so frontmatter and tooling parse reliably.

ENF001_StackedAttributes._why: Stacking two attribute decorators (e.g. [Attribute(...)] followed by [RplProp(...)]) breaks the Enforce Script parser.

ENF002_ArrayCompoundAssign._why: Enforce Script rejects compound assignment (+=, -=, *=, /=) on array element accessors like arr[i] += x.

ENF003_NoTernary._why: Enforce Script has no ternary (?:) operator; using it fails compilation and desyncs the parser.

ENF004_ScriptsLowercase._why: The addon scripts directory must be lowercase 'scripts' for case-sensitive Linux dedicated servers.
